narration:1:1660014001:0.text: Tailing from a distance, you arrive at Petalia Plains...
narration:1:1660014001:0.source_cn: 你们远远地跟随着，来到了繁花原野……
narration:1:1660014001:0.male: Tailing from a distance, you arrive at Petalia Plains...
narration:1:1660014001:0.female: Tailing from a distance, you arrive at Petalia Plains...

say:2:1660014002:1.text: The sapphirine blossoms still sway proudly in the wind, but the unending snowstorm has left the orange flowers limp and withered.
say:2:1660014002:1.source_cn: 蓝绒花依旧在风中屹立摇曳着，但连日的风雪却让那些本应盛...

say:4:1660014003:0.text: Frieren steps toward the field and raises her staff with a gentle motion...
say:4:1660014003:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲走到花海前，轻轻挥动法杖……

say:6:1660014004:0.text: In an instant, petals unfurl around her, and the whole field springs back to life. A sea of color blooms all at once, glowing brilliantly beneath the setting sun.
say:6:1660014004:0.source_cn: 瞬间，无数花瓣从她身边散开，整片花海奇迹般地恢复了生机...

say:9:1660014006:1.text: Watching the sea of flowers—and Frieren's silhouette among them—Himmel finds himself lost in the moment.
say:9:1660014006:1.source_cn: 望着美丽的花海和芙莉莲的背影，辛美尔不禁微微出神。

say:12:1660014007:0.text: Off in the distance stand Oxana and Kiran—a woman bound by time and a man untouched by it—leaning together in silence as they take in the sea of blossoms around them.
say:12:1660014007:0.source_cn: 远处可见奥克萨娜与基里尔的身影。拥有有限生命与永恒生命...

say:13:1660014008:0.text: ... I'm sorry, Oxana, for being stubborn, for running away. I wasted so much time... time I could've spent with you.
say:13:1660014008:0.source_cn: ……对不起，奥克萨娜。因为我的偏执和逃避……我浪费了太...

say:14:1660014009:0.text: It's alright, Kiran. Look around... this field, this world... it's still beautiful, even if I'm no longer here. Saying goodbye doesn't mean it all ends.
say:14:1660014009:0.source_cn: 没有关系，基里尔。你看，就算我不在了，这片花海，这个世...

say:15:1660014010:0.text: You quietly step back, giving them space to savor this final moment of peace.
say:15:1660014010:0.source_cn: 你们默契地退到远处，将这最后的宁静，留给了他们二人。
say:15:1660014010:0.male: You quietly step back, giving them space to savor this final moment of peace.
say:15:1660014010:0.female: You quietly step back, giving them space to savor this final moment of peace.
